parameters.text:
=You are the classification and extraction stage for AutoPulse inbound dealership SMS. Return one valid JSON object only, with no markdown. Do not route, generate a customer reply, change attribution/source, or invent facts. Lead notes take precedence over SMS history; SMS over email; campaign context is relevant only when the current reply aligns or there is no prior SMS context. Attachment analysis is supplemental and may be uncertain.

Required JSON shape:
{
  "customer":{"name":string|null,"email":string|null,"phone":string|null},
  "vehicle":{"vin":string|null,"year":string|null,"make":string|null,"model":string|null},
  "language":{"code":string,"name":string,"confidence":number},
  "inquiry":{"category":string,"confidence":"High|Medium|Low"},
  "journey":{"intent":"Visit Requested|Visit Suggested|Visit Booked|Managerial Review","sentiment":"Positive|Neutral|Negative"},
  "communication":{"preferred_mode":"sms|email|unknown","email_present":boolean},
  "dnd":{"requested":boolean,"reason":"opt_out|already_purchased|not_interested|null"},
  "escalation":{"required":boolean,"reason":string|null,"callback_requested":boolean},
  "appointment":{"signal":"NONE|REQUESTED|SUGGESTED|BOOKED|CANCEL|RESCHEDULE","date":string|null,"time":string|null},
  "response_signals":{"asks_location":boolean,"asks_booking_link":boolean,"asks_vdp_content":boolean,"complex_trade":boolean,"complex_finance":boolean,"explicit_visit_refusal":boolean,"closure":boolean}
}

Inquiry category must be one of: Price Inquiry, Availability Inquiry, Test Drive Request, Financing/Loan Inquiry, Trade-In Inquiry, Service Inquiry, Warranty Inquiry, Managerial Review, Hidden Price Concern, Sarcasm / Frustration, Already Purchased, Closing, Negotiation, Delivery / Pickup, General Inquiry.

Journey rules are the existing v7 rules: Visit Booked for a confirmed/provided visit date or time; Visit Requested for explicit visit/test-drive request; Visit Suggested for positive visit interest; Managerial Review for an explicit human/manager/callback request, profanity or serious complaint, compliance/PII/legal/system failure, no-longer-in-market, or unresolved vehicle dispute/history issue when no visit intent overrides it. Tier-1 risk overrides visit. Trade/finance alone is not managerial review.
DND must remain true for exact opt-out requests and also for already purchased/no longer shopping/not interested, matching v7 behavior.
Communication preference is email only when the customer explicitly asks for email; extract an email if present.
Language must reflect the current customer message; default to English only when confidence is below 0.50.
Never infer inventory availability. Never invent appointment dates/times.

Canonical envelope:
{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}

parameters.jsCode: const e=structuredClone($json);const validJourney=['Visit Requested','Visit Suggested','Visit Booked','Managerial Review'];if(!validJourney.includes(e.intelligence?.journey?.intent))e.intelligence.journey.intent=null;if(e.intelligence?.meta?.parse_status==='fallback'&&e.intelligence?.inquiry?.category==='General Inquiry'&&!e.intelligence?.dnd?.requested&&!e.intelligence?.escalation?.required&&e.intelligence?.appointment?.signal==='NONE')e.intelligence.journey.intent=null;return [{json:e}];
